history_note: (Adopted January 19, 1973, effective September 1, 1973. Amended May 22, 1987, by Laws 1976, p. 837, § 1, effective January 1, 1988, with notation that amendment may be followed after July 1, 1987; amended June 1, 1993, effective January 1, 1994; amended March 22, 1994, effective January 1, 1995.)
note: Prior rule texts are not published on courts.mo.gov rule pages; the chronology comes from the Court's history note. For the SCOPE §2(b) test, a decision predating the last effective date requires comparison with the amending order (courts.mo.gov 'Orders For Rules', page.jsp?id=128693; Missouri Bar copies) — not yet ingested.
